user_prompt: What is the effect of indirect training (exercises that are NOT pelvic floor muscle contractions, e.g. general core, hip, or trunk exercises) COMBINED WITH direct pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT), compared with direct PFMT alone, on incontinence-related quality of life in women with urinary incontinence?  The treatment arm must include BOTH indirect training AND direct PFMT together — not indirect training alone (that is a different comparison in this same review). The control arm is direct PFMT alone, with no added indirect component.  Do not include studies comparing indirect training ALONE (with no PFMT) to direct PFMT, and do not include studies comparing co-ordinated training (body movements performed WITH simultaneous pelvic floor muscle contraction) to direct PFMT — both are separate comparisons in this review, using the same "direct PFMT" comparator but a different treatment arm.  This is the single target outcome — do not pool other outcomes (incontinence episodes, subjective cure/improvement, satisfaction).
